about: The home-screen widget's snapshot (feature 16): what the app hands the widget, as JSON. The app builds it (lib/features/widget/widget_snapshot.dart) and the widget only draws it, so this file pins the shape for both sides: test/widget_snapshot_test.dart builds each example from the inputs its 'why' gives, and the widget's Android tests read the same examples. Every text is ready-made by the app, and amounts are formatted in the journal's currency (USD here, locale en_US). Without Plus, or with the app lock on, nothing from the journal is in it.
rules: version is 1. A widget ignores a snapshot whose version it doesn't know.
state is "plus" (no Plus: the widget shows text.plus), "locked" (the app lock is on: it shows text.locked) or "ready". "plus" comes before "locked".
theme is the theme's id, and "default" without Plus.
Only a ready snapshot has day, spentToday and goal.
day is the phone's local date the snapshot was made for (YYYY-MM-DD). When the phone's date is past it, today shows text.nothingToday and the goal stays.
spentToday is the sum of that day's spends, formatted: "$0.00" when the day has entries but no spend, null when it has none (the widget then shows text.nothingToday).
goal is null (the widget shows text.noGoal) or has name, progress, bands (5 booleans, band i lit once it's reached) and label (for screen readers).

examples.why: Plus, lock off, today 2026-10-02: spends of 3.50 and 12.00 and a save of 100.00 today, a spend of 9.00 the day before; the goal Bike, 320.00 of 1,000.00 (32 %: band 1)
Plus, lock off, theme sea, today 2026-10-02: only the day before's spend; no goal
Plus, lock off, today 2026-10-02: a save of 100.00 today and no spend; the goal Trip, 600.00 of 500.00 (past it: every band, 100 %)
Plus, the app lock on, theme sea: W1's journal, none of it in the snapshot
No Plus (with the lock on too), theme sea: W1's journal, none of it in the snapshot, and the default theme
